description: Inspected H-bridge terminal template with user-specified coil and drive band; not an executable simulation.

electrical_model.type: RL loss model plus receiver-reflected impedance when specified
electrical_model.note: AC equivalent resistance includes loss; do not add the full AC value to DCR. Frequency/current/temperature dependence and receiver loading are unspecified.

operating_point.modulation: phase-shifted full bridge; nominal 50% leg duty before dead-time
operating_point.phase_convention: phi is the separation of the two 50% leg-midpoint square waves; phi=0 cancels differential voltage, phi=pi gives full bipolar drive
operating_point.note: User supplied target band and phase-shift control. Bus voltage, selected operating frequency, phase/dead time and receiver load remain unspecified. Do not infer actual bus voltage from the datasheet 20 V test condition.
operating_point.bus_voltage_note: User supplied approximately 24 V; not an inferred datasheet test voltage.

note: Conduction/freewheel states are topology candidates; actual modulation and commutation behavior require drive/load information. Do not enable both devices of one leg as a conduction state.
